title: Act: Register admin round routes from an adminRoute table
summary: Introduce adminRoute and adminRoutes(rh) for round routes and register via loop.
description: Replace inline round registrations in server.New with a loop over a table so tests can reuse the same list.
acceptance_criteria: Round routes are registered via the table with unchanged paths and methods.
adminRoutes returns the five round routes.

steps.action: Add type adminRoute struct{Method, Pattern string; Handler http.HandlerFunc} and func adminRoundRoutes(rh *admin.RoundHandler) []adminRoute returning the five round routes using rh.Create, rh.Open, rh.Close, rh.Get, rh.Contributions.
steps.expected: Package compiles with the new table function.

steps.action: Remove the five inline ar.Post/ar.Get round registrations and add a loop over adminRoundRoutes(rh) calling ar.Method(route.Method, route.Pattern, route.Handler); keep the three execution registrations and ar.Use(admin.Middleware(...)).
